load_cached_pretrained_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from a text file and cache them as a pickle for fast reuse
match_pretrained_embeddings: match pretrained embeddings to a vocabulary index by exact or lowercase word key lookup
normalize_embeddings: normalize embeddings by subtracting the mean of matched indices and zero out unmatched indices
get_embeds_vocab: build a cached vocabulary set from multiple embedding file paths with specified dimensions
SingleEmbedder: create a single PyTorch embedding layer initialized with pretrained word vectors and frozen weights
